notes.title: Bumpstick Demo is coming to Steam Next Fest June!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey![/h2]

Just a quick announcement here: Bumpstick's demo is going to be playable at the [b]Steam Next Fest, 19th of June[/b], which also happens to be the 170th day of the year! Not that this makes any difference!

Anyway, here's the trailer:

[previewyoutube=xc2nY59E5ak;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Awesome Demo Contents[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] 12 [b]super fun[/b] levels
[*] replays that let you watch your smooth moves over and over again
[*] local co-op, so you can have great loads of fun with your beautiful friends
[*] a bunch of customization options, just for you, snowflake
[*] a button that opens up the store page, where you can wishlist the game
[/list]
With this amazing piece of marketing out of the way,

[h3]see you at the fest![/h3]
